mapper.select: -- Count announcements for dynamic input ownership validation. SELECT count(1) FROM announcements a WHERE a.id = #{announcementId}

-- Select dynamic input requirements configured for an announcement. SELECT air.id AS requirement_id, air.announcement_id, air.field_key, air.field_label, air.field_type_code, air.scope_code, air.is_required, air.is_sensitive, air.sort_order, air.help_text FROM announcement_input_requirements air WHERE air.announcement_id = #{announcementId} ORDER BY air.sort_order ASC, air.field_key ASC, air.id ASC

-- Select dynamic input options for all announcement requirements. SELECT aio.id AS option_id, aio.requirement_id, aio.option_code, aio.option_label, aio.sort_order FROM announcement_input_options aio INNER JOIN announcement_input_requirements air ON air.id = aio.requirement_id WHERE air.announcement_id = #{announcementId} ORDER BY air.sort_order ASC, aio.sort_order ASC, aio.option_code ASC, aio.id ASC

-- Select dynamic input options for one requirement. SELECT aio.id AS option_id, aio.requirement_id, aio.option_code, aio.option_label, aio.sort_order FROM announcement_input_options aio WHERE aio.requirement_id = #{requirementId} ORDER BY aio.sort_order ASC, aio.option_code ASC, aio.id ASC
-- Count progresses to protect immutable dynamic input contract fields. SELECT count(1) FROM application_progresses ap WHERE ap.announcement_id = #{announcementId}
-- Count submitted input values for one requirement. SELECT count(1) FROM application_input_values aiv WHERE aiv.requirement_id = #{requirementId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert dynamic announcement input requirement. INSERT INTO announcement_input_requirements ( id, announcement_id, field_key, field_label, field_type_code, scope_code, is_required, is_sensitive, sort_order, help_text, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{requirementId}, #{announcementId}, #{fieldKey}, #{fieldLabel}, #{fieldTypeCode}, #{scopeCode}, #{required}, #{sensitive}, #{sortOrder}, #{helpText}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update dynamic announcement input requirement without changing primary key. UPDATE announcement_input_requirements SET field_label = #{fieldLabel}, field_type_code = #{fieldTypeCode}, scope_code = #{scopeCode}, is_required = #{required}, is_sensitive = #{sensitive}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, help_text = #{helpText}, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{requirementId} AND announcement_id = #{announcementId} AND field_key = #{fieldKey}
mapper.insert: -- Insert dynamic input option. INSERT INTO announcement_input_options ( id, requirement_id, option_code, option_label, sort_order, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{optionId}, #{requirementId}, #{optionCode}, #{optionLabel}, #{sortOrder}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.select: -- Select progress ownership and announcement for dynamic input values. SELECT ap.id AS progress_id, ap.announcement_id, ap.member_user_id FROM application_progresses ap WHERE ap.id = #{progressId}

-- Select submitted dynamic input values for one progress. SELECT aiv.id AS input_value_id, aiv.progress_id, aiv.requirement_id, aiv.value_text, aiv.value_number, aiv.value_date, aiv.value_boolean, aiv.option_code, aiv.submitted_by, aiv.submitted_at FROM application_input_values aiv WHERE aiv.progress_id = #{progressId} ORDER BY aiv.submitted_at DESC, aiv.option_code ASC, aiv.id ASC
mapper.insert: -- Insert one submitted dynamic input value without audit metadata. INSERT INTO application_input_values ( id, progress_id, requirement_id, value_text, value_number, value_date, value_boolean, option_code, submitted_by ) VALUES ( #{inputValueId}, #{progressId}, #{requirementId}, #{valueText}, #{valueNumber}, #{valueDate}, #{valueBoolean}, #{optionCode}, #{submittedBy} )
mapper.update: -- Refresh progress activity timestamp after dynamic input save. UPDATE application_progresses SET updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{progressId}
mapper.select: -- Count missing required dynamic input values before progress action. SELECT count(1) FROM application_progresses ap INNER JOIN announcement_input_requirements air ON air.announcement_id = ap.announcement_id WHERE ap.id = #{progressId} AND air.is_required = true AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM application_input_values aiv WHERE aiv.progress_id = ap.id AND aiv.requirement_id = air.id )
mapper.insert: -- Insert non-PII dynamic input audit log. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
